calls.video_title: Invest $580 a Month Into These ETFs. Retire a Millionaire
calls.thesis: Growth-bucket ETF pick; semiconductor fund weighted by size, Nvidia ~23%; $10k 10 years ago would be ~$185k today.
calls.bull_case: Chip sales expected to nearly double to ~$1.5T this year, ~$1.9T by 2027, mostly AI memory chips.
calls.bear_case: Heavy Nvidia concentration (23%); chips had best 15 years ever — 2000-2011 chip sales grew ~50% while stocks lost money.

calls.thesis: Core AI/semiconductor ETF holding for years; 'treated me like gold'.
